contents.name: Host
contents.description: The IP address or hostname of the Modbus TCP device or gateway (e.g. "10.0.0.5").

contents.name: Port
contents.description: The Modbus TCP port of the device (e.g. 502, the IANA-registered Modbus default).

contents.name: UnitIdentifier
contents.description: The Modbus unit identifier (0-255) routed in the MBAP header (e.g. 255). Conventionally 255 when addressing a Modbus TCP device directly; identifies one downstream slave (1-247) when connecting through a TCP-to-serial gateway. Warning: 0 is the serial broadcast address when forwarded through a gateway - slaves execute the request but never answer, so every request against it will time out; some direct TCP devices do accept 0 as "me". 248-254 are reserved by the specification and accepted as configured.

contents.name: DefaultReadCycleInterval
contents.description: Default poll interval in seconds (e.g. 10) for streams that do not set their own ReadCycleInterval.

contents.name: WriteCycleInterval
contents.description: The Modbus write cycle interval in seconds (e.g. 10) for cyclically writing configured Parameter values to the device.

contents.name: Streams
contents.description: Contains all Modbus streams of the given device.

contents.name: Parameter
contents.description: For writing configuration values to the Modbus device.
